title: Cloud Security: settlement precision
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for settlement precision.

## Basis

Currency: Invoice and settlement currency; ISO currency string.

Monetary decimal precision: Monetary decimal places; integer.

Meter quantity decimal precision: Meter quantity decimal places; integer.

Rounding convention: Decimal tie-breaking convention for monetary and quantity rounding; string.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Currency | Monetary decimal precision | Meter quantity decimal precision | Rounding convention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | USD | 2 | 6 | half up |

## Tier comparison

The listed settlement precision bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
